subject: general
question: Sikkim became an Associate State of the Indian Union through
solution:
The correct answer is **__the Constitution (35th Amendment) Act, 1974.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f8dee5cef1b5a840c9cef1a94c98c6a15a87d7243cb8a980eea081210303ee2.png] 

**The question asks "associate statehood" and not full statehood. So, the answer is the 35th amendment and NOT the 36th amendment**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Constitution (36th Amendment) Act, 1975: **** **

 
 
• The act provides that the** Legislative assembly of Sikkim** shall not consist of more than 32 members.
 
• The Assembly of Sikkim unanimously adopted a resolution on **10th April 1974 with 32 members.**
 
• It is then proposed to include Sikkim as a full-fledged state in the First Schedule to the Constitution.
 
• And allot to Sikkim one seat in the council of states and one seat in the House of People.
 
• It is also proposed to insert a new article containing the provisions considered necessary to meet the special circumstances and needs of Sikkim.
 
• This Act made Sikkim a full-fledged state of the Indian Union and Omitted the Tenth schedule.
 
• **Option 1 is not correct because the question is asking about an Associate State, not a Full-Fledged state.**
 
 
 
• **The Consitution (7th Amendment) Act, 1956:**
 
 
• To implement the recommendations of the state reorganization commission regarding reorganizing of states on a linguistic basis.
 
• It inserted Articles 258A, 290A, 298, 350A, 350B, 371, 372A, and 378A.
 
• It amended PART VIII and schedules 1, 2, 4, and 7.
 
 
 
• **The Constitution (35th Amendment) Act, 1974:**
 
 
• This Act Terminated the Protectorate status of Sikkim and conferred the status of an **associate state of the Indian Union.**
 
• Hence option 3 is correct.
 
• The Tenth Schedule was added laying down the terms and conditions of association of Sikkim with the Indian Union.
 
 
 
• A new **Article 2(A)** was inserted after Article 2 in the Indian Constitution, which says **Sikkim to be associated with the Union**.
 
 
• The Tenth Schedule was added after the Ninth Schedule to the Indian Constitution.
 
• Tenth Schedule: Articles 2(A), 80(1), and 81(1).
 
 
 
• **The Constitution (5th Amendment) Act, 1955:**
 
 
• It amended Article 3 of The Indian Constitution which enables Parliament to effect, by law, the reorganization of states constituting the Indian Union.
 
• Hence option 4 is not correct.
